sourceText: “I wish you to judge for me entirely,” was the reply. “I have lost confidence in myself.”

attempts.label: primary
attempts.visibleOutput:
TRANSLATION: “mi wile e ni: sina o toki taso e pona anu ike pi ijo ni tawa mi,” toki ante li ni. “mi pilin ala e ni: mi ken sona pona e nasin mi.”
